units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 29:7">Targ. Ex. XXIX, 7</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 54ᵈ bot. <he>הוה ליה משח וכ׳</he> had oil which he took down to Acco (for sale).
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>ההוא מִישְׁחָךְ וכ׳</he> (not <he>מישחף</he>, some ed. <cite ref="M01312"><he>מישחא</he></cite>) that oil of thine at Beth M.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 37a:5">Ab. Zar. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>דשרו מ׳</he> who permitted oil (of gentiles).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a:8">Ib. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ דאווזא</he> goose-fat; a. fr.
Targ. Is. XLI, 19 אעין דמ׳ pine-wood (h. text עצי שמן, v. דדנין).—
